district: San Bernardino City Unified School District
summary: A Yes vote authorizes the district to issue general obligation bonds, repaid by property taxes, to fund school facilities.

tax.text: A Yes vote would authorize a bond funded by a property tax to pay for school facility improvements.
tax.quote: If approved by voters, homeowners would pay approximately $50 per $100,000 of assessed (not market) value while bonds are outstanding.
